# Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts

> > The #1 ranked online culinary school offering flexible degree and diploma programs in culinary arts, baking & pastry, food entrepreneurship, plant-based cooking, holistic nutrition, and hospitality management with campuses in Boulder, CO and Austin, TX.

Auguste Escoffier School of Culinary Arts is a leading culinary education institution specializing in both online and on-campus programs. The school serves aspiring chefs, pastry professionals, food entrepreneurs, and wellness coaches with comprehensive culinary and hospitality education.

## Key Topics

- Culinary Arts
- Baking & Pastry Arts
- Online Degree Programs
- Food Entrepreneurship

## Academic Programs

- [Online Culinary Arts Degree](https://www.escoffier.edu/academics/culinary-arts-online): Online culinary arts degree and diploma program from top-ranked school
- [Online Baking & Pastry Arts Degree](https://www.escoffier.edu/academics/baking-pastry-online): Online baking and pastry arts degree program for aspiring pastry chefs
- [Food Entrepreneurship Programs](https://www.escoffier.edu/food-entrepreneurship): Diploma and degree programs for starting food businesses and startups
- [Plant-Based Culinary Programs](https://www.escoffier.edu/plant-based-programs): Plant-based culinary programs focusing on nutrition and sustainability
- [Holistic Nutrition & Wellness Programs](https://www.escoffier.edu/holistic-nutrition-and-wellness): Online degree and diploma in holistic nutrition, wellness, and health coaching
- [Hospitality Management Degree](https://www.escoffier.edu/academics/food-and-beverage-online): Online hospitality management degree for hotel and restaurant operations
- [Online Programs Overview](https://www.escoffier.edu/about/campuses/online-programs): Overview of flexible online culinary, pastry, and specialized degree programs

## Admissions & Enrollment
